name: ChatAssistant
description:
An assistant chat card: a header, the conversation, a "thinking" status, suggestion chips and a composer - the Appica homepage's assistant, composed from UI primitives.

  ChatAssistant(title: "Appica Assistant", action: chat_messages_path) do
    ChatHeader()
    ChatMessages do
      ChatMessage(from: :user) { "Make the Pro tier featured." }
      ChatStatus { "Generating preview" }
    end
    ChatSuggestions([ "Add a FAQ section", "Use dark theme" ])
    ChatComposer(placeholder: "Ask anything…")
  end

The composer is a real form posting `message` to `action:` (Turbo submits it); answer with `turbo_stream.append messages_id, Blocks::ChatMessage.new(from: :assistant) { … }`. Without an `action:` it runs a demo that replies with `demo_replies:` - handy in previews.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes Blocks (e.g. `ChatAssistant(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

default: Done - have a look at the preview.

ChatComposer.description: The message form: a text field with attach, dictate and send buttons. Posts `name:` to the root's `action:`; the Stimulus controller shows the message right away and clears the field.

ChatHeader.description: The assistant's avatar (with an online badge) and name.

ChatMessage.description: One chat bubble: the user's on the inline-end side, the assistant's on the start side.

ChatMessages.description: The scrolling conversation. Its id (the root's `messages_id`) is the Turbo Stream target for new messages.

ChatStatus.description: The assistant's "working on it" row with the sparkle spinner. Shown while a reply is pending.

ChatSuggestion.description: One suggestion chip (an outline Button at Appica's chip size).

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes:
The Appica homepage card. The last request is still "generating" when the page loads; the
demo finishes it, then answers anything you send.
examples.code:
copy = sample

phlex do
  ChatAssistant(title: title.presence || copy[:title], status: (online ? :online : :offline), demo_replies: copy[:replies], class: "h-120 w-100 max-w-full") do
    ChatHeader()
    ChatMessages do
      copy[:conversation].each_with_index { |text, index| ChatMessage(from: index.even? ? :user : :assistant) { text } }
      ChatStatus { copy[:status] }
    end
    ChatSuggestions(copy[:suggestions])
    ChatComposer()
  end
end

examples.name: Empty state
examples.notes: A fresh conversation: a greeting from the assistant and a few starters.
examples.code:
copy = sample

phlex do
  ChatAssistant(title: copy[:title], demo_replies: copy[:replies], class: "h-100 w-100 max-w-full") do
    ChatHeader()
    ChatMessages do
      ChatMessage { copy[:empty][:greeting] }
      ChatStatus(hidden: true)
    end
    ChatSuggestions(copy[:empty][:starters])
    ChatComposer(placeholder: copy[:empty][:placeholder])
  end
end

examples.name: Long conversation
examples.notes: The messages scroll inside a fixed-height card and stay pinned to the latest one.
examples.code:
copy = sample

phlex do
  ChatAssistant(title: copy[:title], demo_replies: copy[:replies], class: "h-100 w-100 max-w-full") do
    ChatHeader()
    ChatMessages do
      1.upto(6) do |n|
        ChatMessage(from: :user) { copy[:long][:request] % { n: } }
        ChatMessage { copy[:long][:reply] % { n: } }
      end
      ChatStatus(hidden: true)
    end
    ChatComposer()
  end
end

examples.name: Offline
examples.notes: `status: :offline` greys the badge, stops its pulse and disables the composer.
examples.code:
copy = sample

phlex do
  ChatAssistant(title: copy[:title], status: :offline, class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    ChatHeader()
    ChatMessages do
      ChatMessage { copy[:offline][:message] }
    end
    ChatComposer(placeholder: copy[:offline][:placeholder])
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes:
Rendered in Arabic whatever the toolbar says: bubbles swap sides with the reading direction
and their corner "tails" follow (logical radii).
examples.code:
copy = I18n.with_locale(:ar) { sample }

phlex do
  I18n.with_locale(:ar) do
    div(dir: "rtl") do
      ChatAssistant(title: copy[:title], demo_replies: copy[:replies], class: "h-100 w-100 max-w-full") do
        ChatHeader()
        ChatMessages do
          copy[:conversation].first(2).each_with_index { |text, index| ChatMessage(from: index.even? ? :user : :assistant) { text } }
          ChatStatus(hidden: true)
        end
        ChatSuggestions(copy[:suggestions].first(1))
        ChatComposer()
      end
    end
  end
end
